Website design for roofing companies

When a roof leaks, people search on their phone and call the first roofer who looks reliable. We build roofing websites that make that call easy: from €495 for a one-page site, €995 for a business website. All prices are final prices in euros: no VAT is added.

What a homeowner checks in ten seconds

Someone with water coming through the ceiling does not read long stories. They look for four things and then decide whether to call you or the next result:

  • Do you do this job? Repairs, re-roofing, flat roofs, gutters, chimneys, storm damage. Clear service names, not a vague "roofing solutions".
  • Do you work in my area? Your towns and postcodes on the page, so they do not have to guess.
  • Can I trust you? Real photos of your own jobs, your trade memberships and insurance details, and your reviews.
  • How fast can I reach you? A phone number they can tap, visible at the top of every screen, and a short form for a free inspection.

Most roofing sites fail on one of these, usually the phone number or the service area. That is what we fix first.

What goes on a good roofing website

  • Phone number in the header, tappable on mobile, so calling takes one tap
  • A free inspection or quote form with four or five fields, and the phone field optional
  • Services spelled out: repairs, replacement, flat roofs, gutters and fascias, chimneys, storm and leak repairs, whatever you really do
  • Your service area, listed by town, so Google and visitors both understand where you work
  • Before-and-after photos of your own work, compressed so the page still loads fast on 4G
  • Trust details: trade association memberships, insurance and guarantees, only the ones you actually have
  • Reviews linked from your Google Business Profile, never invented or copied
  • Fast and mobile-first: most people looking for a roofer search on their phone

Getting found on Google in your area

For a roofer, the searches that matter are local: "roofer near me", "roof repair" plus your town, "flat roof replacement" plus your county. A website helps you show up for those when each service has clear text, your towns are named, and your business details (name, address, phone) match your Google Business Profile exactly. We set up the technical basics Google expects: clear page titles, a sitemap, structured data for a local business and a Search Console connection. Nobody can promise you the top spot, because competition and reviews also count, but you start with a site Google can read well.

Answering enquiries when you are on a roof

You cannot pick up the phone halfway up a ladder. Two optional extras help here. A simple automation (from €395) can put every web enquiry straight into a sheet and send the customer a confirmation, so nobody waits in silence. An AI chatbot (from €995) can answer common questions such as your service area or whether you do emergency repairs, using only your own information, and pass anything else to you. Start with the website; add these only if enquiries are slipping through.

How it works

  1. Email us your business name, the services you offer and the area you cover. A link to your current site or Facebook page helps.
  2. Within 48 hours you get a free concept of your homepage, made for your business, not a template with your logo on it.
  3. You approve the design and the fixed price.
  4. We build, you check it on your own phone, we launch.

Frequently asked questions

How fast can my roofing website be live?

A one-page site is usually live in 3 to 5 days, a business website in 2 to 3 weeks. You get a free concept within 48 hours first. Speed mostly depends on how quickly you can send photos of your work and your list of services and towns; we write the copy for you.

I don't have good photos. Is that a problem?

No, but your own photos work best, because customers want to see your work, not stock images. Photos taken on a phone are fine. Send a few before-and-after shots of recent jobs and we will crop, compress and place them. Until then we can use neutral images that are clearly not presented as your projects.

Do you work with roofers outside the Netherlands?

Yes. We work fully online, by email and video, in English or Dutch, with clients in for example the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia and New Zealand. Prices are the same final prices in euros everywhere, and we write your copy the way customers in your country search.

Can you add reviews to my site?

Yes, real ones. We can link or show reviews from your Google Business Profile or another review platform you use. We never write or copy reviews, and we will not add trust badges or memberships you do not have.

What are the monthly costs?

A domain costs around €10 to €25 a year and hosting is free for most small sites. Maintenance by us is optional from €29 a month. If you add an AI chatbot, the AI usage itself usually costs a few euros to a few tens of euros a month, and we estimate that up front.

Who owns the website?

The website, the domain and the content are registered in your name. If you later want to work with someone else, you take everything with you.
